items.briefing:
Australian staff should be alert to two active threats right now. A phishing service is impersonating RingCentral to steal Microsoft 365 login credentials — if you receive an unexpected RingCentral email asking you to sign in, don't click the link. Separately, Scamwatch is warning about gambling and betting scams, which are increasingly targeting Australians through fake promotions and fraudulent betting platforms.

**Practical tip:** If you're ever asked to log into Microsoft 365 through a link in an email, go directly to the Microsoft 365 website yourself instead of clicking the link.

featured.title: Device Code Phishing Up 1,500% in 2026; Vishing Doubles
featured.quote: Device code phishing attacks surged 1,500% in 2026, bypassing traditional security controls.
